ROUTING_CONTRACT.applies_to: An AUTHENTICATED subject. An unauthenticated subject is out of scope and its existing redirect to /login is preserved verbatim at every site.
ROUTING_CONTRACT.evaluation_order_is_normative: The four rules below are ORDERED. An implementation that evaluates them in a different order can produce a different destination for the same principal, so the order is part of the contract, not a presentation choice.

R1_SUPER_ADMIN_PRESERVED_VERBATIM.rule: Where the existing super-admin contract applies, it is preserved VERBATIM and is evaluated BEFORE any selector question.

R1_SUPER_ADMIN_PRESERVED_VERBATIM.prohibition: A super-admin without a membership MUST NOT be routed to /app/organizations/select. R2_NO_CARRIER.action: Call the EXISTING selectable-membership enumerator: listSelectableMemberships(), exported from lib/auth/session.ts:83 as a re-export of lib/auth/database-context.ts:661.
R2_NO_CARRIER.branch_one_or_more: candidates.length >= 1 -> route to /app/organizations/select. THIS INCLUDES candidates.length === 1.

R3_STALE_OR_NON_MEMBER_CARRIER.action: Clear the stale carrier, THEN route to /app/organizations/select carrying the governed refusal/error semantics already implemented for that route.
R3_STALE_OR_NON_MEMBER_CARRIER.ordering_is_normative: The carrier is cleared BEFORE the redirect is issued. If the redirect were issued first, the next request would re-enter R3 with the same stale carrier and the graph would not terminate.

This contract REUSES that key and MUST NOT invent a new error vocabulary.
R3_STALE_OR_NON_MEMBER_CARRIER.fallback_prohibition: Never fall back to another membership, not even when the subject holds exactly one other active membership. This is SECOND_ORG_MEMBERSHIP B4, whose B4_classification names it 'the failure mode most likely to be introduced as a UX nicety'. Routing the subject to the selector is not a fallback: the subject chooses, the application does not choose for them.

NO_CARRIER_WRITE_DURING_ROUTING.rule: No rule of this contract writes the selected-organization carrier. R3 CLEARS a carrier; clearing is not selecting, and it leaves the subject with no scope rather than with a scope they did not choose.

NO_AUTO_SELECTION.rule: For candidates.length === 1 the destination is the SELECTOR, identically to candidates.length >= 2. The single-candidate case gets no shortcut.
prohibited_selection_strategies: automatic selection of the sole candidate
pick-first / .limit(1) over an unqualified user predicate
any inference of scope from whatever memberships happen to exist
any carrier write performed by a routing decision rather than by the governed selection act
